title: Engine and theoretical-baseline validation
purpose: Verify simulated MV accuracy against closed forms (independent; common-shock; two-class mixture; Bahadur) and golden fixtures
primary_outcome: |A_sim - A_theory| within 4 Monte Carlo SE per cell
status: exploratory run (design probe PROBE-EXP001 with exploratory seeds, results/exploratory/probe-engine-validation; confirmatory run awaits owner freeze)
planned_analysis: Per-cell deviation in SE units; golden fixtures to 1e-9; stop rule if any cell fails

title: Equal-budget aggregation map (primary)
purpose: Map where MV CW SEQ DELIB improve or degrade accuracy vs a single reasoner at matched budget
primary_outcome: Delta accuracy vs SINGLE (paired by item and seed)
status: planned (protocol draft, awaiting owner freeze; implementation done at M2; DELIB degenerate as drafted, see proposed amendment A-2)
planned_analysis: Seed-level t and bootstrap 95% intervals; Holm-adjusted one-sided bounds for H0; predictions P1-P3

title: Dependence-structure sensitivity
purpose: Test whether the sign of Delta_MV at matched marginal competence and pairwise correlation depends on the dependence model
primary_outcome: Sign agreement of Delta_MV across four dependence models
status: planned (protocol draft, awaiting owner freeze; implementation done at M2)
planned_analysis: Exact analytic values plus Monte Carlo seed-level intervals; admissibility exclusions reported

title: Robustness to secondary design choices (optional)
purpose: Check EXP-002 signs under tie rule; cost accounting; confidence scale; herding strength
primary_outcome: Sign stability of significant EXP-002 contrasts
status: planned (protocol draft, awaiting owner freeze; implementation done at M2; tie-rule abstain level not implemented)
